summary: Spruce Power Holding Corp filed an 8-K reporting a completed change in domicile from Delaware to Texas, effective October 30, 2026, via certificates of conversion filed in both states; the filing is captioned under Item 3.03 (material modifications to security holder rights) rather than 8.01. Each outstanding Delaware share converted one-for-one into Texas common stock, with no change to headquarters, business, employees, assets, liabilities or material contracts, and no exchange of book-entry positions required. Exhibit materials reference the Texas charter and bylaws and plan continuations. This is a routine reincorporation with no deal economics; nothing for risk-arb.
